title: Simulation 3D Physics Vehicle
text: 实现可控的 6DOF 车辆 3D 环境，输入 4 路、输出 5 路；按 {Color, VehColor} 指定车辆颜色；{Type, PassVehMesh} 指定 Type Muscle、{Name, ActorName} 指定车辆名称 SimulinkVehicle1、{Initial position [X, Y, Z], InitialPos [m]} 指定车辆初始位置、{Initial rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw], InitialRot [rad]} 指定车辆初始旋转、{Mass, Mass [kg]} 指定车辆质量、{Center of mass offset vector, CgOffset [m]} 指定质心偏移、{Inertia tensor scaling vector, IvehScale []} 指定惯性张量的缩放、{Chassis height (used in drag), ChassisHeight [m]} 指定底盘高度、{Drag coefficient, Cd []} 指定车辆阻力系数、{Drag lift coefficient, Cl []} 指定纵向升力系数、{Path to custom mesh, MeshPath} 指定 Path to custom mesh、{Track width, TrackWidth [m]} 指定车轮间距、{Wheel base in custom mesh [m]} 指定自定义网格中的轴距、{Front Wheel radius, FrntWhlRadius [m]} 指定前轮半径、{Front wheel width, FrntWhlWidth [m]} 指定前轮宽度、{Rear Wheel radius, RearWhlRadius [m]} 指定后轮半径、{Rear wheel width, RearWhlWidth [m]} 指定后轮宽度、{Motor torque indices, TrqCrv [Nm]} 指定电机扭矩索引、{Motor speed breakpoints, SpdCrv [rpm]} 指定电机转速断点、{Maximum powertrain speed, MaxRPM [rpm]} 指定最大动力总成转速、{Powertrain rotational inertia, Jmot [kg*m^2]} 指定动力总成转动惯量、{Powertrain damping at full torque request, bEngMax [Nms/rad]} 指定全扭矩请求时的动力总成阻尼、{Powertrain damping at zero torque request in gear, bEngMin [Nms/rad]} 指定挂挡时零扭矩请求下的动力总成阻尼、{Drivetrain type} 指定传动系统 Rear Wheel、{Front to rear torque split ratio, FrntRearSplit []} 指定前后扭矩分配比、{Transmission type} 指定变速器 Automatic、{Gear number vector, G []} 指定挡位编号、{Gear ratio vector, N []} 指定传动比、{Upshift speed, UpShiftRPM [rpm]} 指定升挡转速、{Downshift speed, DownShiftRPM [rpm]} 指定降挡转速、{Minimum (idle) speed, MinRPM [rpm]} 指定最小动力总成转速、{Shift time, tShift [s]} 指定完成换挡所需时间、{Final drive ratio, NDiff []} 指定主减速比、{Transmission efficiency, eta []} 指定效率因子、{Steering type} 用于设置转向类型、{Outside to inside steering ratio, SteerAngleRatio []} 指定外侧与内侧转向角比、{Front wheel max steer angle, FrntWhlMaxSteer [rad]} 指定前轮最大转向角、{Rear wheel max steer angle, RearWhlMaxSteer [rad]} 指定后轮最大转向角、{Maximum steering ratio breakpoints, SteerCrv []} 指定最大转向比、{Steering ratio speed breakpoints, SteerSpdCrv [m/s]} 指定转向比车速断点、{Maximum front wheel torque, FrntWhlMaxTrq [Nm]} 指定前轮最大扭矩、{Maximum rear wheel torque, RearWhlMaxTrq [Nm]} 指定后轮最大扭矩、{Option to enable handbrake input} 启用手刹输入、{Front wheels affected by handbrake} 指定前轮手刹、{Rear wheels affected by handbrake} 指定后轮手刹、{Maximum front wheel hand brake torque, FrntWhlMaxHndBrkTrq [Nm]} 指定前轮最大手刹扭矩、{Maximum rear wheel hand brake torque, RearWhlMaxHndBrkTrq [Nm]} 指定后轮最大手刹扭矩、{Front suspension force offset location, FrntSuspFOffset [m]} 指定前悬架力偏移、{Maximum front suspension compression (jounce), FrntSuspMaxComp [m]} 指定前悬架最大压缩量、{Front spring preload, FrntSpringPreload [N]} 指定前悬架预紧力、{Front spring stiffness, FrntSpringRate [N/m]} 指定前悬架弹簧刚度 30e3、{Maximum front suspension extension (rebound), FrntSuspMaxExt [m]} 指定前悬架最大伸张量、{Front suspension damping ratio, FrntSuspDamping []} 指定前悬架阻尼比、{Front roll bar stiffness scaling, FrntRollbarScaling []} 指定前抗侧倾效果、{Rear suspension force offset location, RearSuspFOffset [m]} 指定后悬架力偏移、{Maximum rear suspension compression (jounce), RearSuspMaxComp [m]} 指定后悬架最大压缩量、{Rear spring preload, RearSpringPreload [N]} 指定后悬架预紧力、{Rear spring stiffness, RearSpringRate [N/m]} 指定后悬架弹簧刚度 30e3、{Maximum rear suspension extension (rebound), RearSuspMaxExt [m]} 指定后悬架最大伸张量、{Rear suspension damping ratio, RearSuspDamping []} 指定后悬架阻尼比、{Rear roll bar stiffness scaling, RearRollbarScaling []} 指定后抗侧倾效果、{Enable anti-lock braking} 启用防抱死制动、{Enable traction control} 启用牵引力控制、{Front wheel corner stiffness, Cy_f [N/rad]} 指定前轮侧偏刚度 70e3、{Front wheel slip modifier, FrntSideSlipModifier []} 指定前轮滑移修正系数、{Rear wheel corner stiffness, Cy_r [N/rad]} 指定后轮侧偏刚度 70e3、{Rear wheel slip modifier, RearSideSlipModifier []} 指定后轮滑移修正系数、{Friction scaling factor, lambda_mu []} 指定摩擦缩放、{Enable light controls} 控制车辆车灯、{Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor} 指定前照灯颜色、{High beam intensity, HighBeamIntensity} 指定远光强度、{Low beam intensity, LowBeamIntensity} 指定近光强度、{High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle} 指定远光锥半角、{Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle} 指定近光锥半角、{Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation} 指定左前照灯光束方向、{Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation} 指定右前照灯光束方向、{Brake light intensity, BrakelightIntensity} 指定制动灯强度、{Reverse light intensity, ReverselightIntensity} 指定倒车灯强度、{Turn signal light intensity, SignallightIntensity} 指定转向信号灯强度、{Period, SignallightPeriod} 指定转向信号灯周期、{Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth} 指定脉冲宽度、{Sample time, SampleTime} 指定采样时间、{Output location and orientation} 指定返回位置和方向、{Output nominal vehicle state feedback} 指定返回标称车辆状态反馈，按实例取值。
